{{Quote|I was one of them. They don't like the fact that I left just to cash in on their location by providing others with their whereabouts. Say, would you like to know? Free of charge! I also know a little bit about other activities on this planet.|Lock Vlash, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LV" />}}
'''Lock Vlash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|AHH! Stay away from me! I didn't mean to--oh. You're not a part of Lord Nyax's Clan. What a relief! You scared me there. I am right, aren't I? You're not a spy, are you? ... are you?!|Lock Vlash, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LV" />}}
Lock Vlash once joined the Corellian sect known as the [[Cult of Lord Nyax|Followers of Nyax]]. However, he finally managed to leave the Cult. Although he successfully escaped, Vlash remained worried that some cultists could try to take revenge on him. Furthermore, the relations between Vlash and the Cult deteriorated even more when the former intended to sell the location of the [[Lord Nyax's Cult hideout]].<ref name="SWG:LV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Lock Vlash met a spacer in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] and agreed to share the location of Lord Nyax's Cult hideout, but also the location of the [[Afarathu Cave]] and the [[Imperial Stronghold (Corellia)|Imperial Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:LV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lock Vlash was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:LV" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lock Vlash was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 5 Notes: 16 December 03|Publish 5]]" update, released on [[December 16]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref>
